name: Soulsevered (CR +0)
body:
There are some pockets of the universe where the influence of the Imperatives is not felt and still others in which their machinations are known and repelled through rituals or other alterations. The product is the same in both cases: living creatures which exist without a soul to be found in their body.

These creatures live a life outside the boundaries of souls and the magics built upon them, a prospect which worries some but has little effect on the physical or moral character of these beings.

Soulsevered is an acquired or inherited template which can be applied to any living creature. A soulsevered creature uses the statistics of the base creature except as follows.

Challenge Rating: Same as base creature (+0).

Defensive Abilities: A soulsevered creature gains the following defensive abilities.

Freed of the Cycle (Ex)

A soulsevered creature is immune to positive and negative energy effects, being neither healed nor harmed by either (this also makes them immune to cure or inflict spells). They are immune to death effects, negative levels, and any effect which would target their soul. This also means that soulsevered cannot be raised or resurrected by any means short of a wish or miracle spell, nor can they be raised as undead.

Natural Mind (Ex)

The absence of a soul makes a soulsevered creature more difficult to manipulate or gauge by magical means. A soulsevered creature gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against divination effects and supernatural mind-affecting effects (including spells, powers, and similar effects).
